summary: Global Net Lease, Inc. (GNL) filed an 8-K announcing an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Modiv Industrial, Inc. Modiv will merge into a GNL subsidiary, with GNL as the acquirer. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal. Consideration structure per share and premium were not disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction involves REIT and OpCo merger subs; regulatory approvals and shareholder votes are required. Risk-arb: watch for stock-for-stock ratio details, regulatory timeline, and closing conditions; typical REIT merger dynamics apply.
